questions.prompt: Find the area of a triangle with base 10 m and height 6 m.
Find the area of a trapezium with parallel sides 6 m and 10 m, 4 m apart.
Find the circumference of a circle of diameter 14 cm (π = 22/7).
Find the area of a circle of radius 7 cm (π = 22/7).
Choose one Space Architect problem. Explain which formula you used, why, and how you checked the units.
questions.modelAnswer: For the water tank, I used volume = l × b × h because the tank is a cuboid. I first converted 1 m to 100 cm so all lengths were in cm: 100 × 50 × 40 = 2,00,000 cm³. Since 1 L = 1000 cm³, that is 200 L. Checking units: cm × cm × cm = cm³, then converted to litres.
